title: Kyle Shanahan expects 49ers fan takeover vs. Rams in Melbourne

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan expects 49ers fan takeover vs. Rams in Melbourne
sources.description: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan has been salty about the Rams' desire to export a home game to Australia, in order to avoid yet another San Francisco-fan takeover of SoFi Stadium.
